scientific_integrity: Classical Gaussian/noncentral-chi-square and spectral source-condition tools are acknowledged; first-publication evidence is arXiv v1 2026-10-01. Self-review only. Existing probabilistic facts are not presented as independently discovered. Related older Gaussian confidence-set texts were not fully inspected.
scientific_limitations: Fixed deterministic Landweber iteration on full-column-rank matrices with exact known Gaussian covariance, known source-ball constants, and strictly positive spectral filter. Spectral asymptotics vary a family of full-rank matrices toward singularity. Optimality is within fixed-covariance-shape ellipsoids centered at the given iterate; randomized covariance estimates, data-adaptive stopping, and arbitrary confidence regions are excluded.
title: Sharp covariance-aligned Landweber confidence radii and a half-order spectral transition
